u = u[:i].replace(dec,\"\") + \".\" + u[i+1:]\n    elif \",\" in u or \".\" in u:\n        sep = \",\" if \",\" in u else \".\"\n        i = u.rfind(sep); tail = u[i+1:]\n        u = (u[:i].replace(sep,\"\") + \".\" + tail) if len(tail)==2 else u.replace(sep,\"\")\n    v = float(u)\n    return -v if neg else v\n\ndef run(adj_div=100.0, loose_paren=False, waive_over_nan=False):\n    rows=[]\n    for idx, rec in enumerate(csv.DictReader(open('/app/dataset/data.csv'))):\n        base = parse_amount(rec[\"amount_str\"], loose_paren)\n        s = rec[\"notes\"] or \"\"\n        m = re.search(r\"items\\s*=\\s*([+-]?\\d+)\", s, re.I); items = int(m.group(1)) if m else None\n        m = re.search(r\"adj\\s*=\\s*([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*%\", s, re.I); adj = float(m.group(1))/adj_div if m else 0.0\n        m = re.search(r\"fee\\s*=\\s*([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", s, re.I); fee = float(m.group(1)) if m else 0.0\n        waive = re.search(r\"waive\\s*=\\s*true\", s, re.I) is not None\n        if waive_over_nan and waive: net = 0.0\n        elif math.isnan(base): net = float(\"nan\")\n        elif waive: net = 0.0\n        else: net = base*(1+adj)+fee\n        ts=None\n        if rec[\"event_time\"].strip():\n            ts = datetime.strptime(rec[\"event_time\"].strip(), \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n        rows.append((idx, rec[\"record_id\"], ts, rec[\"region\"], rec[\"channel\"], items, net))\n    min_ts = datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    best={}\n    for idx, rid, ts, reg, ch, items, net in rows:\n        key = (ts or min_ts, not math.isnan(net), -idx)\n        if rid not in best or key > best[rid][0]:\n            best[rid] = (key, (idx,rid,ts,reg,ch,items,net))\n    lo=datetime(2025,10,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc); hi=datetime(2025,12,31,23,59,59,tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    kept=[r for _,r in best.values() if r[2] and lo<=r[2]<=hi and r[4].strip().lower()!=\"phone\" and math.isfinite(r[6])]\n    groups={}\n    for r in kept: groups.setdefault((r[3], r[2].strftime(\"%Y-%m\")), []).append(r)\n    scored=[]\n    for members in groups.values():\n        nets=[m[6] for m in members]; med=median(nets); mad=median(abs(n-med) for n in nets)\n        for m in members:\n            z = 0.0 if mad==0 else 0.6745*(m[6]-med)/mad\n            ie = max(m[5] if m[5] is not None else 1, 1)\n            scored.append((m[1], abs(z)*math.log1p(ie), abs(z), m[2]))\n    scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], -x[2], -x[3].timestamp(), x[0]))\n    return [s[0] for s in scored[:10]]\n\nbase = run()\nprint(\"baseline:            \", base)\nfor name, kw in [(\"adj not /100\", dict(adj_div=1.0)),\n                 (\"loose parens\", dict(loose_paren=True)),\n                 (\"waive beats NaN\", dict(waive_over_nan=True)),\n                 (\"loose+adj raw\", dict(adj_div=1.0, loose_paren=True))]:\n    alt = run(**kw)\n    print(f\"{name:21}\", alt, \"SAME\" if alt==base else \"DIFFERENT\")\nEOF","description":"Test answer sensitivity to ambiguous rule interpretations"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1958,"cache_read_input_tokens":35158,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1958,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72097f64-7bac-4cb6-b8bd-d2cdbc7d1ab8","uuid":"56f66483-6209-4177-b0c9-b30e5f341998","request_id":"req_011Ccs22gKRdJoKjRhFkXusR"}
